name: animated-switch
title: Animated Switch
description: A toggle between on and off.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette for the track, thumb, marks and focus ring. Primary uses its primary colour; Green, Blue, Orange and Rose use its success, info, warning and destructive colours.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: variant
props.label: Switch type
props.description: Elastic stretches the thumb as it moves; Apple copies the iOS switch.

props.name: color
props.label: On colour
props.description: Track colour when the switch is on.

props.name: appleGreen
props.label: Apple green
props.description: Uses iOS green for the on track. Only for the Apple type with On colour set to Foreground.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the track and thumb.

props.name: showMarks
props.label: Show marks
props.description: Shows on and off marks inside the track.

props.name: labelPosition
props.label: Label position
props.description: Where the label sits relative to the switch.

props.name: pressSqueeze
props.label: Press squeeze
props.description: How much the thumb squashes when pressed (Elastic) or widens (Apple, which stops changing above about 0.27).

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the thumb takes to move, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: Springiness of the thumb when it lands. 0 means no overshoot.
